card.name: Random characters in YouTube links
card.fires_on: Pieces of the random ID code at the end of YouTube watch links, such as single letters, digits or short letter groups. Also fires weakly on scattered mid-phrase words in general web prose.

modes.label: YouTube link ID
modes.description: Characters inside the random video ID after watch?v= in a web link.

modes.label: Partway through compounds
modes.description: A word or hyphenated piece in the middle of a phrase in ordinary web prose.
modes.example: exploding mine looks like a climactic full<<-page>> panel from a Japanese comic or manga.

card.plain: It lights up on the jumbled letters and numbers inside YouTube links, and rarely on odd mid-phrase words.
